mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_log (tenant_id, user_id, user_name, ip_address, status, message) VALUES (COALESCE(#{tenantId}, 0), #{userId}, #{userName}, #{ipAddress}, #{status}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM login_log WHERE status = 1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(login_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM login_log WHERE status = 1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND login_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
